full_judgment:
Mustafa Kamal, J:- The plaintiff petitioner's suit, Title Suit No. 71 of 1982, for declaration of title and recovery of possession was decreed in part by the learned Munsif, Sadar, Kushtia by judgment and decree dated 24-8-85, decreeing the plain-tiffs title to the suit land to the extent of 1/5th share to which he is entitled to possession after evicting defendant No. 1 or any body else claiming under him. On appeal by the plaintiffs, Title Appeal No. 221 of 1985, the learned Additional District Judge, Kushtia by judgment and decree dated 14-7-92 affirmed the judgment and decree of the trial Court. The plaintiff-petitioner's revision, Civil Order No. 2502 of 1992, was dismissed summarily by a Single Bench of the High Court Division by judgment and order dated 31-8-92. 

 5. Mr.Akram Hossain Amin, learned Advocate-on-Record for the plaintiff-petitioners submits that the High Court Division erred in not taking into consideration that the suit property being an ejmali property cannot be treated as vested property without prior partition of the same. He further submits that the High Court Division failed to take into consideration that the Courts below in not passing  a decree in the suit in its entirety commit-ted an error of law occasioning a failure of justice.
